meaning: 1 = this shot visibly contains the throwing-side action of a delivery; 0 = no such action; null = setup or action boundary cannot be decided from this review packet

ambiguous_notes.S12: Red player prepares and moves the stone before a close view; the exact action boundary with S13 is unclear.

limitations: One agent reviewed three source frames per cut-defined shot; this is not independent annotation.
A hard-cut scan can miss edits, and some long shots change phase internally.
Shot labels are not exact release times or throw-event ground truth.
